title: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C) with a pizza stone inside if available.
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce over the dough.
Tear fresh mozzarella into pieces and distribute evenly.
Bake for 8–12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
Top with fresh basil leaves and drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt.

title: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil until softened.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, broth, and bay leaf; bring to a boil.
Simmer 25–30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper; remove bay leaf and serve.

title: Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry; fold in blueberries.
Cook on a lightly buttered griddle over medium heat until bubbles form; flip and cook until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

title: Spicy Chickpea Salad Wrap
instructions: Mash chickpeas with lemon juice, tahini, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread mixture on a whole wheat wrap.
Top with sliced cucumber, tomato, and mixed greens.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve some pasta water.
Sauté garlic in butter and olive oil until fragrant.
Add shrimp and red pepper flakes; cook until just pink.
Toss shrimp with spaghetti, a splash of pasta water, lemon juice, and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
instructions: Blend avocados, cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla, a pinch of salt, and almond milk until silky.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.
